body:
## Goal

Give `.card-title` a `min-height` equal to two lines of text in [`quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss) so the guest/author name below the title aligns consistently across cards regardless of whether the title spans one or two lines.

## Context

Requested by @XenonMolecule via `/implement` on PR #94.

The `.card-title` rule (around line 210) already clamps titles to two lines with `-webkit-line-clamp: 2` and uses `line-height: 1.35` at `font-size: 0.95rem`. Single-line titles currently occupy less vertical space than two-line titles, causing the `.episode-guest` author name to sit at different heights across cards in the carousel.

Reserving two lines of height for every title (e.g. `min-height: calc(1.35em * 2)`, or `2 * line-height`) will keep the author name vertically aligned.

Note there is also a responsive `.card-title` override (around line 304) that sets `font-size: 0.85rem`. Ensure the min-height approach still aligns correctly at that breakpoint, since a fixed `em`-based min-height scales with the smaller font size while a fixed `px`/`rem` value would not.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `.card-title` reserves the vertical space of two lines of text, so the author name (`.episode-guest`) aligns across cards whether the title is one or two lines.
- Existing two-line truncation behavior (`-webkit-line-clamp: 2`, overflow hidden) is preserved.
- Alignment holds at the responsive breakpoint where `.card-title` font-size changes.
- Change is scoped to `episodeCarousel.scss`.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/94

This keeps the `.episode-guest` author name (absolutely positioned to the bottom of `.card-content`) vertically aligned across cards whether a title is one or two lines. The value is em-based (line-height 1.35 × 2 lines), so it scales with the element font-size and stays correct at the sidebar breakpoint where `.card-title` drops to 0.85rem. Existing 2-line truncation (`-webkit-line-clamp: 2`, overflow hidden) is unchanged. No build/formatter was available in this environment (no node_modules), but the change is a single standard CSS property.
